Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[Governor of Iowa]] [[Tom Vilsack]] sought re-election to a second term as governor. He won his party's nomination uncontested, while Doug Gross, an advisor to former and future Governor [[Terry Branstad]], narrowly won the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] primary in a crowded and competitive election. In the general election, Vilsack was able to improve slightly on his margin of victory four years earlier to win what would be his second and final term as governor. ==Democratic primary==
